key.name: camera
key.description: The libcamera id of the camera opened last.

key.name: modes
key.description: Maps a camera id to the last chosen sensor mode, as WIDTHxHEIGHT.

key.name: raw
key.description: Write a DNG next to each photo when the camera offers a raw stream.

key.name: show-info
key.description: Show exposure, sensitivity, white balance, focus and frame rate over the viewfinder.

key.name: full-resolution
key.description: Take photos at the full photo size, switching the camera from its faster viewfinder mode for a moment; when off, photos come straight from the viewfinder.

key.name: shutter-sound
key.description: Play the feedback theme's shutter sound or vibration when taking a picture or starting and stopping a recording.

key.name: video
key.description: Whether the shutter records video rather than taking photos.

key.name: grid
key.description: Draw a rule-of-thirds grid over the viewfinder.

key.name: timer
key.description: Seconds between pressing the shutter and taking the picture; 0 for none.
